verdict.rationale: Capsule's own docs confirm a first-party import of contacts from a spreadsheet or CSV, so the core import capability exists. Nothing covers deals or opportunities import, field mapping, validation, or error reporting that would prevent silent row loss. missing for 10: deal/opportunity import, field-mapping UI, validation and error/rejected-row reporting, guarantees against silent row loss, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a founder, I can import my spreadsheet of contacts and deals with field mapping and validation, without losing rows silently

citations.quote: Bring your contacts to Capsule by importing them from a spreadhseet, CSV and more.
